description: Single-seat F-104A displayed on the University of Jordan campus at Jubeiha in north-west Amman. It wears the serial 912, but the International F-104 Society records the genuine 912 as being at Balila and carries this aircraft as an unidentified F-104A first seen in 2008 with its identity still unknown, so the tail number is left blank. Spottingmode takes the painted 912 at face value and attaches construction number 183-1085 to it.
